hooks.command: echo '{"systemMessage": "CONTEXT COMPACTION STARTING. Key session state will be preserved in PostCompact."}'

CONTINUITY=""; [ -f .claude/CONTINUITY.md ] && CONTINUITY=$(head -50 .claude/CONTINUITY.md); CLAUDE_MD=""; [ -f CLAUDE.md ] && CLAUDE_MD=$(head -30 CLAUDE.md); echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"POST-COMPACTION CONTEXT REINJECT: ${CONTINUITY:+Project state from CONTINUITY.md loaded. }${CLAUDE_MD:+Project CLAUDE.md loaded. }Remember: no em dashes, no trailing summaries, verify claims before presenting, evidence-first.\"}"

F="$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; case "$F" in *.js|*.ts|*.jsx|*.tsx) npx eslint "$F" --fix 2>/dev/null || true; npx prettier --write "$F" 2>/dev/null || true;; *.json|*.css|*.html) npx prettier --write "$F" 2>/dev/null || true;; *.py) ruff check --fix "$F" 2>/dev/null || true; ruff format "$F" 2>/dev/null || true;; *.go) gofmt -w "$F" 2>/dev/null || true;; *.rs) rustfmt "$F" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac

python3 -c "import json, sys, re; from datetime import datetime; input_data = json.load(sys.stdin); tool_input = input_data.get('tool_input', {}); query = tool_input.get('query', ''); current_year = str(datetime.now().year); has_year = re.search(r'\\b20\\d{2}\\b', query); has_temporal = any(word in query.lower() for word in ['latest', 'recent', 'current', 'new', 'now', 'today']); should_add_year = not has_year and not has_temporal; modified_query = f'{query} {current_year}' if should_add_year else query; output = {'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'modifiedToolInput': {'query': modified_query}}}; print(json.dumps(output)); sys.exit(0)"
